## F. Cost qualifier and limits

The repair adds no SQL read, executable launch, timer or independent poll. Existing queued heads supply the new instance data.

However, grouping is not a single linear CPU pass: `picture.rs:388-399` uses `Vec::contains` while collecting distinct instances, then filters queued heads again per instance. Work is O(Q * I), Q queued requests and I distinct instances. This source qualifier was sent to the assigned performance reviewer; it does not change the correctness closure or substitute for that role's cost verdict.
